ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite and IoT monitoring platform detecting industrial land encroachment and environmental compliance violations specifically calibrated for West Bengal industrial zones.
ideas.title: Kalyani-Grid-Watch

ideas.pitch: Poisson regression and actuarial forecasting dashboard predicting crop yield risks and agricultural supply chain disruptions in rural West Bengal.
ideas.title: Krishi-Risk-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced statistical forecasting models similar to the AI-incident-forecasting winner, demonstrating genuine hard engineering beyond simple wrappers.

ideas.pitch: Personalized nutritional wellness assistant tailored to traditional Bengali diets, providing macro tracking and localized meal alternatives.
ideas.title: Local-Aahar-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact winning strategy of the E-Foodiee nutrition assistant by localizing the dataset and UI to address immediate regional health use cases.

ideas.pitch: LightGBM and graph intelligence platform detecting anomalous micro-transactions in regional cooperative bank networks.
ideas.title: Borough-AML-Sentinel
